failed_witnesses.failed_witness: The first activation-baton display exceeded its bounded output and truncated before EOF.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Read the same immutable Git blob in bounded sixty-line slices through its final line.
failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Treat a truncated display as unread and resume the same blob by deterministic line windows.

failed_witnesses.failed_witness: A combined authorization skill, schema, and state display truncated before the complete state was attributable.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Read the skill, schema, overlays, and state in separate bounded UTF-8 windows through EOF.
failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Project large state documents separately and prove the final line before claiming a complete read.

failed_witnesses.failed_witness: A PowerShell foreach expression was piped before materialization and failed parsing before any mutation.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Materialized the foreach results into an array before applying the pipeline projection.
failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Wrap or assign foreach output before piping in PowerShell.

failed_witnesses.failed_witness: The first worktree wrapper returned after preparation began, and an immediate path probe raced the still-running checkout.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Waited for the exact existing checkout process, then verified the literal worktree path, branch, head, sparse set, and clean state.
failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Poll the same attributable checkout process and never start a second worktree creation after an early wrapper return.

failed_witnesses.failed_witness: A broad worktree and process recovery projection truncated among unrelated worktree output.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Used exact process waiting and literal path, branch, head, and sparse-pattern probes.
failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Use scalar owner-path probes instead of broad worktree enumeration during recovery.

failed_witnesses.failed_witness: The first x1 builder inherited the Windows CP-1252 subprocess decoder and stopped on a valid UTF-8 historical proposal blob before writing the freeze.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Changed only Git text decoding to explicit strict UTF-8 and repeated the interrupted owner-local build dependency.
failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Every Git text subprocess in the phase declares UTF-8 explicitly; byte-domain reads remain bytes.

failed_witnesses.failed_witness: The UTF-8-corrected builder completed its semantic scan but then addressed a stale nested path for Caelen's immutable proposal freeze and stopped before writing Orin artifacts.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Resolved the exact proposal-freeze path from the immutable source tree and changed only that source selector.
failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Resolve inherited artifact paths from the exact source tree rather than projecting a previous owner's directory convention.

failed_witnesses.failed_witness: The first exact x1 staged review reported review_required for three matches inside the privacy scanner's own pattern definitions.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Adjudicated the three visible scanner-definition candidates separately from confirmed payload hits and retained both counts.
failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Scanner candidates and confirmed payload hits are separate fields; scanner-definition text is never silently dropped.
